text:
Maya: Quick sync — GearHub launch in two weeks. They requested private offers on the marketplace plus an SI co-sell plug. Need commit bands, renewal rules, and a brief public comms runway.

Theo: I can sketch commit bands. Thinking micro (pilot), core, growth, enterprise. Will post numbers shortly.

Priya: Legal: include credit expiry, non-transferability, and a maximum per-account credit cap. Also please avoid absolute auto-renew language without explicit consent.

Omar: Ops: we need SKU names and a deploy mapping. Prefer separate SKUs per deployment type to keep meters clean.

Elena: Sales: field wants a simple renewal boost: if customer renews within 30 days early, give 3% uplift for first renewal only. And an early-convert incentive for pilots that convert within 30 days.

Theo: Draft bands below (ballpark):

```
Pilot: $8k commit/yr -> 0% discount + $2k pilot credit, 3m term
Core: $60k commit/yr -> 10% discount + $10k onboarding credit, 12m term
Growth: $220k commit/yr -> 18% discount + $25k onboarding credit, 12m term
Enterprise: $600k+ commit/yr -> 30% discount + $60k onboarding credit + priority queue, 12/24 term
```

Priya: Legal note: onboarding credits must expire 180 days, non-transferable, and not redeemable for cash. Early-convert limited to first contract per customer. I'll write PO snippets if you confirm numbers.

Omar: Ops: separate SKUs per deployment OK. Proposed naming: sku.gearhub.<deployment>.<band>.<term> e.g., sku.gearhub.hosted.core.12m. Send CSV by Thu EOD.

Elena: For co-sell credits we need a definition of qualifying activity (joint demo + lead registration + co-marketing asset). Let's codify that.

Maya: Agree. Also set a soft cap $45k per account on co-sell credits; anything above needs GM sign-off.

Theo: Suggest per-deal cap = min(30% of committed value, $45k). Keeps it predictable.

Priya: Legal OK on those caps. We'll add an approval flow in the Marketplace PR for credits > $20k.

partners-bot: GearHub asked for 72-hr pre-notice on public comms. Link: https://gearhub.example/commsdraft

Maya: We'll hold to 48 business-hour mutual review, no unilateral publishes. If partner insists on 72, escalate to me.

Omar: Ops timeline: if numbers lock by Friday, we can prepare market listings and run QA next week. Need final SKU names by Thu.

Elena: Field enablement: I'll produce two one-pagers (SI qualification + renewal play) and a short recorded walkthrough.

Theo: I'll run the finance sensitivity and post updated bands Weds AM.

Priya: I'll draft the PO language (credits, expiry, co-sell definition, approval steps) and drop in this thread for review.

Maya: Thanks. Action items: Theo -> finance sensitivity + final bands; Priya -> legal PO snippets; Omar -> SKU CSV template; Elena -> enablement artifacts. Lock everything by Friday EOD.

partners-bot: Reminder set — follow-up Friday 09:00 PT.
